leadText:
Pokémon Elements is a collection of DVDs published by VIZ Media. It is the successor to the series, with the first volumes released just three months after that series ended. Each DVD includes three episodes of , with a theme of one specific Pokémon type.

All ten volumes were released two at a time, with new volumes being released from July 28, 2009 to March 23, 2010. Two collections were released on August 31, 2010 and January 25, 2011, containing five volumes each.
plainText:
Pokémon Elements is a collection of DVDs published by VIZ Media. It is the successor to the series, with the first volumes released just three months after that series ended. Each DVD includes three episodes of , with a theme of one specific Pokémon type.

All ten volumes were released two at a time, with new volumes being released from July 28, 2009 to March 23, 2010. Two collections were released on August 31, 2010 and January 25, 2011, containing five volumes each.

==Pokémon Elements volumes==
===Volume 1: ===
 
Volume 1: Grass was released on July 28, 2009. It has the ISBN 1-4215-3017-1.
 
 
 
 
 

===Volume 2: ===
 
Volume 2: Fire was released on July 28, 2009. It has the ISBN 1-4215-3018-X.
 
 
 
 
 

===Volume 3: ===
 
Volume 3: Water was released on September 29, 2009. It has the ISBN 1-4215-3019-8.
 
 
 
 
 

===Volume 4: ===
 
Volume 4: Electric was released on September 29, 2009. It has the ISBN 1-4215-3020-1.
 
 
 
 
 

===Volume 5: ===
 
Volume 5: Ice was released on November 24, 2009. It has the ISBN 1-4215-3021-X.
 
 
 
 
 

===Volume 6: ===
 
Volume 6: Dark was released on November 24, 2009. It has the ISBN 1-4215-3022-8.
 
 
 
 
 

===Volume 7: ===
 
Volume 7: Psychic was released on January 26, 2010. It has the ISBN 1-4215-3023-6.
 
 
 
 
 

===Volume 8: ===
 
Volume 8: Dragon was released on January 26, 2010. It has the ISBN 1-4215-3024-4.
 
 
 
 
 

===Volume 9: ===
 
Volume 9: Ghost was released on March 23, 2010. It has the ISBN 1-4215-3158-5.
 
 
 
 
 

===Volume 10: ===
 
Volume 10: Rock was released on March 23, 2010. It has the ISBN 1-4215-3159-3.
 
 
 
 
 

==Collections==
===Collection 1===
 
The Pokémon Elements Collection 1 was released on August 31, 2010. It consists of a single DVD case that contains 5 discs, each being the disc of the volumes from Volume 1 to 5.
 
===Collection 2===
 
The Pokémon Elements Collection 2 was released on January 25, 2011. It consists of a single DVD case that contains 5 discs, each being the disc of the volumes from Volume 6 to 10.
